_notes: M37 mode 5 — super-lucky archetype derived from mode 2.
Base byte-identical to mode 2 EXCEPT R2 grand weight (52 -> 166, scaling 3.19x).
Mechanism: per universal §C mode 5 = mode 2 + grand boost only. Public M37Cfg skin 5 vs skin 2 evidence supports this (~6x grand boost).
All other R2 symbols (mini/minor/major/bars/high7) + R1 + R3 byte-identical to mode 2.

v4 (2026-05-08): rescaled weights using prod's per-reel asymmetric pattern R1/R3 max≤30, R2 max≤800. Buffalo sampler breaks at large weight magnitudes (M37 v3 had R1/R3 max=700-750, R2 max=1029, gave real-RTP 580%). prod uses R1/R3 max=21, R2 max=800 — works fine. Marginals + RTP unchanged within rounding precision.
